title: Note branch-per-stage review stacks
summary: Add the multi-branch stacked-diff topology to future improvements.
rationale: The experiment validated linear commit rewriting but revealed a user expectation that each semantic stage may also have a visible branch pointer.

decisions.summary: Use a deterministic linear stage-branch stack in v0.1.
decisions.rationale: Branch-per-stage refs improve local visibility and remain compatible with stacked remote reviews, but require deterministic downstream ref movement and hosting-neutral preparation.

validation.summary: The roadmap distinguishes the current linear v0.1 model from the deferred branch-per-stage option and lists the required safety concerns.
